title: Claude Fable 5 Launch
description: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5, a Mythos-class model safe for general use, alongside Claude Mythos 5 as part of the next generation of intelligence.

title: Enterprise Admin Permissions with Custom Roles
description: Extended the custom roles framework by adding admin permissions, giving members access to specific administrative areas like billing or privacy without requiring Owner status.

title: Bugbot 3x Faster, 22% Cheaper, 10% More Bugs
description: Bugbot average review time dropped from ~5 minutes to ~90 seconds. Finds 10% more bugs per review (0.62 vs 0.56) and costs ~22% less per run, powered by Composer 2.5.

community_feedback.quote: Discussions about Bugbot usage-based pricing, costs ~$1.00-$1.50 per run

title: /review Command for Pre-Push Checks
description: Run Bugbot and Security Review before pushing with `/review`. Syncs with Bugbot on GitHub/GitLab, recognizing already-reviewed diffs.

title: Organizations for Cursor Enterprise
description: Enterprise customers can manage multiple teams from one place with different security, governance, budget, and feature controls for each.

title: GitHub Agentic Workflows Public Preview
description: GitHub Agentic Workflows entered public preview, enabling multi-step automation tasks with Copilot CLI as the underlying engine.

title: Agentic Workflows No Longer Need Personal Access Token
description: Removed the requirement for personal access tokens in agentic workflows, simplifying authentication.

title: Copilot CLI: Configure Everything from /settings
description: New /settings command in Copilot CLI provides unified configuration management.

title: Claude Fable 5 Generally Available
description: Claude Fable 5 is now generally available for GitHub Copilot.

title: Copilot Chat Sees Agent Sessions
description: Copilot Chat now has visibility into agent sessions for better context awareness.

title: Dedicated Security Review Command in Copilot CLI
description: New dedicated security review command now available in Copilot CLI for application security scanning.

title: Cloud and Local Sandboxes for Copilot Public Preview
description: Cloud and local sandboxes for GitHub Copilot entered public preview for application security and platform governance.

title: Copilot SDK Generally Available
description: Copilot SDK is now generally available for developers building integrations.

title: Copilot CLI: Improved UI, Rubber Duck, Scheduling, Voice Input
description: Copilot CLI received improved UI, rubber duck mode, prompt scheduling, and voice input capabilities.

title: Larger Context Windows and Configurable Reasoning Levels
description: GitHub Copilot now supports larger context windows and configurable reasoning levels.

title: Pending PR Reviews Automatically Canceled on New Commits
description: Devin Review now automatically cancels pending PR reviews when new commits are pushed, keeping reviews synchronized.

title: Support for Claude 4.5/4.6 Models
description: Added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models and updated model aliases (sonnet/haiku/opus).

title: Expanded Gemini Model Support
description: Expanded Gemini model support with 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite, added Gemini 3 preview models, and updated flash alias.

title: Added Support for OpenAI GPT-5.1/5.2 and GPT-5-Pro Models
description: Added settings for new OpenAI GPT-5.1/5.2 and GPT-5-pro models across OpenAI, Azure, and OpenRouter, including chat and codex variants.

title: v0.86.0 Release
description: Expanded GPT-5 model support across family variants and providers (OpenAI, Azure, OpenRouter), including dated and chat/mini/nano variants.

title: Added /ok Shortcut Command
description: Added /ok as a shortcut for asking aider to proceed with proposed changes, with optional extra instructions.
